result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.count_mutual_node_pairs()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Count mutual node pairs (bidirectional edges) in directed graphs. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L4889-L4929){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.count_mutual_node_pairs() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Returns the number of node pairs `(a,b)` where both edges `a->b` and `b->a` exist. Only works for directed graphs. Self-loops are excluded. This metric is useful for analyzing reciprocity in directed networks like social graphs. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Number of node pairs with edges in both directions. ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ValueError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If graph is undirected. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Count mutual relationships: ::: {#11ad034d .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph(directed=True) .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_edge("A", "B") .add_edge("B", "A") # Mutual with A .add_edge("A", "C") # One-way only ) # Returns 1 graph.count_mutual_node_pairs() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 1 ``` ::: :::
